title: Oaths and Vows
summary: Oaths and vows were solemn commitments made before God and were not to be treated casually.
background: Ancient oath-taking invoked truthfulness, covenant obligation, and accountability before God. Jesus and James warn against manipulative or careless oath speech.
teachingHelp: Teach oaths and vows as serious speech before God, then connect to integrity and truthful discipleship.
